plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for ExaLINK Fusion (Cisco Nexus 3550-F) low-latency switch. It reports uptime, load average (÷100), free memory, temperature sensors, fan RPM, PSU temperature / input power / output power and interface traffic, based on the EXALINK-FUSION-MIB (enterprise PEN 43296). There is no CPU% or memory%.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_load_average
metrics.description: System load average of the ExaLINK Fusion switch (fusionSysInfoLoadAverage). The device reports load ×100; the stored value is already divided by 100.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available memory of the ExaLINK Fusion switch in bytes (fusionSysInfoAvailMem). There is no total-memory object, so memory percent is not computed. Non-positive readings are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of each ExaLINK Fusion temperature sensor in degrees Celsius (fusionTempSensorValue). Readings outside -40..125 C are dropped. PSU temperature is reported separately as psu_temperature_celsius.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed in RPM of each ExaLINK Fusion fan sensor (fusionFanSensorValue). Negative values and readings above 30000 RPM are dropped. Zero RPM on a present fan is kept as a real reading.

metrics.name: psu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each ExaLINK Fusion power supply in degrees Celsius (fusionPsuTemperature). Absent PSU rows (fusionPsuPresent=false) are dropped. Not emitted as device_temperature_celsius so chassis and PSU series stay distinct.

metrics.name: psu_power_in_watts
metrics.description: Input power of each ExaLINK Fusion power supply in watts (fusionPsuPowerIn). Negative values and readings above 5000 W are dropped. Absent PSU rows are dropped.

metrics.name: psu_power_out_watts
metrics.description: Output power of each ExaLINK Fusion power supply in watts (fusionPsuPowerOut). Negative values and readings above 5000 W are dropped. Absent PSU rows are dropped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
